news.title: Is NVIDIA Funding Its Own Stock Rally?
news.summary: If you hold NVIDIA (NVDA) stock, one number deserves your attention: roughly a quarter. That is the share of fiscal 2028 business management expects from AI labs it will back with its own balance sheet. NVIDIA's revenue more than doubled year over year in fiscal Q2 2027, so this number is easy to miss. An important thing to watch is how much future demand depends on NVIDIA backing its own customers.

news.title: A Rejuvenated AI Trade May Not Be Enough to Save the Stock Market

Comments from JPMorgan’s Jamie Dimon on AI spending, pushback from Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI risks, and surge in popularity of  Meta Platform  new AI agent Muse have all played a role in the tech resurgence.  “There were lots worrying investors last week, and there still are,” said Ed Yardeni, founder and CEO of Yardeni Research.
